story.overview:
My experience in creative production spans music, live events, brand development and creative project management. I've worked with artists, creative professionals, businesses and production partners to develop ideas and coordinate the resources needed to bring creative projects to life.

My work sits at the intersection of creativity and execution. Beyond developing ideas, I've been involved in coordinating people, managing creative relationships, facilitating collaborations and overseeing different aspects of project delivery.
story.challenge:
My journey in creative production grew from an interest in bringing ideas to life and working with talented people to create meaningful experiences.

Over time, I became involved in different areas of the creative industry, from music and live entertainment to brand development and design.

These experiences gave me the opportunity to work with artists, creative professionals, businesses and production partners, often taking responsibility for coordinating people and resources across different stages of a project.

One particularly interesting aspect of this journey was coordinating creative collaborations across Africa and Europe, bringing together talent from different geographical locations to contribute to shared creative projects.
story.approach:
My approach to creative production centred on collaboration, coordination and translating creative ideas into finished work.

Music & International Creative Collaboration

I worked with Tianyanosa, coordinating creative professionals across Africa and Europe to facilitate collaborations on music projects.

One of these engagements involved All Fun and Games by Reetkat. I coordinated creative contributors across both regions, helping bring together different talents and perspectives for the project.

My music-related work also included coordinating the development and delivery of an EP, an album and several singles.

Event Production

Between 2022 and 2023, I collaborated with Black Lips Entertainment on live music experiences.

I worked on coordinating production requirements, developing partnerships and securing a hotel partnership that supported the delivery of three events.

The intention was to explore ways of modernising the traditional live-band entertainment experience.

Brand Development & Creative Design

I also undertook brand development and freelance creative engagements.
These projects involved supporting brand development, visual direction and other creative design requirements.
story.contribution:
Across these engagements, my contributions included:

Coordinating creative professionals and collaborators across Africa and Europe.

Managing creative relationships and facilitating international collaborations.

Supporting music project development and delivery.

Coordinating event production and partnership development.

Supporting brand development and visual identity projects.

Managing promotional and creative activities around selected releases and projects.

My role varied across projects, spanning creative coordination, project management, production and brand development.
story.results:
My creative production experience resulted in:

Coordination of creative collaborations across two continents: Africa and Europe.

Contribution to the development and delivery of music projects, including an EP, an album and several singles.

Collaboration on the production of three live music events.

Development of a hotel partnership to support event production.

Brand development and creative design work for businesses, including Charlotte Dior.

Experience coordinating creative professionals and project contributors across different locations.
story.lessons:
Creative production taught me that having a good creative idea is only one part of delivering a successful project.

The quality of execution often depends on the people involved, how well they work together, and the systems used to coordinate their contributions.

Working across geographical boundaries also strengthened my appreciation for communication, relationship management and the importance of aligning different creative perspectives.

Most importantly, these experiences reinforced something I continue to apply in my business and professional work: creativity and execution are not separate disciplines. Great ideas need the right people, coordination and operational discipline to become reality.
